name: Oakland County Parks Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens volunteer in the Oakland County parks. You pick the park site and the kinds of work you like when you apply.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17. A parent or guardian fills out the online application for the teen.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The county takes applications only for current openings posted on Idealist.
how_to_apply: A parent or guardian completes the teen online application. Choose your site and your areas of interest. Open roles are posted on Idealist.
notes: Court-ordered community service is not offered. Groups of 10 or more use a separate group form. Adults 18 and older use a different application.
